description: Search PUBLIC posts by keyword (social listening). Platforms: bluesky (sort latest|top, cursor pagination), threads, and mastodon. Threads keyword search has a Meta-imposed budget shared with the Schedulala dashboard - the response reports usage; prefer bluesky or mastodon for exploratory searching, both of which are free public reads. Mastodon searches the PUBLIC HASHTAG TIMELINE for a single-word query (chronological, every instance) and falls back to full-text search for multi-word queries - full-text only covers posts whose authors opted into indexing, so a thin result set there is not evidence the topic is quiet; the response reports which path ran. Each result includes its reply target so you can respond via reply_to_comment (bluesky: platformData.replyRefs; threads and mastodon: the result id as postId).

accountId.description: Optional. Account to search as (from list_accounts).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response (bluesky only).

q.description: Required. Keyword or phrase to search for.
